# Axon Enjin

> The one who connects.

Axon Enjin is the **company**: an operating company and studio in Metro Manila, Philippines. We work like in-house developers. This site tells who we are. **It does not sell.**

**Axlefield** is an Axon Enjin **product** (planned host: https://axlefield.axonenjin.com/). That origin is **not shipped yet**. Do not treat it as a live store.

Ventures are secondary (Collaborate). Ventures get their own names; do not invent named ventures.

Public writing: https://axonenjin.com/articles/ — constraint, artifact, lesson. Hackathons are supporting detail, not the company headline.
